## v0.3.0 — Remove IR, Settings info screen, UX polish

Minor release. Drops the IR Remote app and expands **Settings** with battery and firmware info. Header navigation and stopwatch display are refined.

**Apps (left/right in the header):** Torch → Timer → Stopwatch → **Settings**

---

### Removed: IR Remote

- IR app, NVS storage, and **IRremote** library dependency removed
- App order is now four apps; header page dots are more compact so `>` stays visible

### Settings

- **Sleep** timeout (unchanged): 30s / 1min / 5min / 10min, NVS-backed
- **Battery:** level (%) and voltage (V) on one line — e.g. `Bat 78% 4.12V`
- **S/W Ver:** firmware version from `config.h`
- Charging status is shown in the **header battery icon** only (horizontal lightning bolt when charging)

### Display sleep fix

- Idle sleep now runs in **header focus** as well as app content (all apps)

### Stopwatch

- Fixed time format: **`hh:mm:ss.cs`** (always two-digit hours, minutes, seconds)

### Header

- Compact page indicator; app switch chevrons pinned so `>` is not clipped

---

### Upgrade from v0.2.1

| Data | Notes |
|------|--------|
| Timer / Stopwatch / Settings | Kept |
| IR devices/buttons | No longer used (app removed) |

Install `cardputer_adv_firmware.bin` via M5Launcher (SD / OTA / WUI).

Serial boot line: `cardputer_adv_firmware 0.3.0`

**Full diff:** https://github.com/bluedskim/cardputer_adv_firmware/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0
